title: cell centers point placer
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkCellCentersPointPlacer constraining a distance widget to cell centers.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCellArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellArray.html) — cell array.
- [vtkCellCentersPointPlacer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellCentersPointPlacer.html) — cell centers point placer.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkDistanceRepresentation2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDistanceRepresentation2D.html) — distance representation2d.
- [vtkDistanceWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDistanceWidget.html) — distance widget.
- [vtkHexahedron](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHexahedron.html) — hexahedron.
- [vtkMatrix4x4](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMatrix4x4.html) — matrix4x4.
- [vtkMatrixToLinearTransform](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMatrixToLinearTransform.html) — matrix to linear transform.
- [vtkPentagonalPrism](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPentagonalPrism.html) — pentagonal prism.
- [vtkPointHandleRepresentation3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPointHandleRepresentation3D.html) — point handle representation3d.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPyramid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPyramid.html) — pyramid.
- [vtkTetra](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTetra.html) — tetra.
- [vtkTransformFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTransformFilter.html) — applies a geometric transformation to a dataset.
- [vtkUnstructuredGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnstructuredGrid.html) — unstructured grid.
- [vtkVoxel](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVoxel.html) — voxel.
- [vtkWedge](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkWedge.html) — wedge.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
